implementationRequirements: Declare state representation explicitly in the candidate execution metadata; do not infer it from model name or silently reinterpret an existing buffer.
Preserve high and low through decay multiplication, state/key reduction, delta update and output accumulation. Merely storing a low component after an already-rounded F32 update is insufficient.
Use independently validated product/sum residual recovery and normalization. Existing AMD compiler cancellation of floating compensation requires actual physical binary/output checks.
Keep both components finite and nonoverlapping; define rounding, subnormal, overflow, signed-zero and FMA/reassociation behavior, with independent operands beyond retained model cases.

Allocate and initialize both components through the existing state owner. Reset, clone, explicit retry, concurrent attempts, cancellation, failed cleanup and device-loss accounting must cover the full doubled buffer.
Fresh candidate attempts only; reject mismatched one-F32 state rather than reinterpret it. Portable checkpoints remain unsupported.
Update current prefill and fused decode variants, exact kernel identities, wrapper byte bounds and observation decoding together; do not combine rejected unrelated shader trials.
